_about: The engine's Claude Code hooks, loaded with the plugin in every instance that enables comms-engine@comms-engine. SessionStart opens the session with the latest monitoring pass and what is new in memory; PreToolUse on Bash refuses a raw platform write that bypasses channels.send(); PreToolUse on Skill refuses a paid skill (motion:generate) without a recorded cost sign-off. All three read only. The scripts find the instance through scripts/paths.py (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, which Claude Code exports to every hook).
